Kuwait’s Oil Facilities Blockaded Amid Ongoing Maritime Dispute, Production Impacted

KUWAIT CITY, June 21 — Several major oil export terminals in Kuwait have been blockaded by unidentified vessels in a sharp escalation of a maritime dispute, disrupting oil and gas shipments and forcing producers to curb output, industry officials said Friday.

The standoff, now in its second day, has left at least four key ports operated by Kuwait’s leading oil and gas companies—including GulfPetro and Al-Sabah Energy—unable to load tankers bound for global markets, according to the Kuwait Oil Producers Association (KOPA).

“Kuwait’s daily crude exports have been reduced by over 40% due to the blockade,” said KOPA spokesperson Yusef Mansour. “Storage facilities are nearing capacity, and if the situation persists, we may have to halt additional production.”

The Kuwaiti government has condemned the move as “an illegal act of aggression,” vowing to seek international mediation. “These actions pose a serious threat to energy security and the stability of the oil market,” Deputy Oil Minister Salim Al-Hashimi told reporters. He did not specify the origin of the vessels but described the situation as “highly sensitive and volatile.”

Shipping data reviewed by the Kuwait Shipping Union shows at least 22 tankers now stranded in Kuwaiti coastal waters or rerouted to other Gulf ports. “We are seeing significant delays and mounting losses for producers,” said union chair Nawal Al-Rashid.

Analysts warn the ongoing disruption could have far-reaching effects. “Kuwait is a critical supplier of oil and liquefied natural gas, particularly to Asian markets,” said Adnan Faris, an independent energy analyst in Dubai. “Even a short-term halt will be felt in global pricing and supply chains.”

No injuries or damage to facilities have been reported so far, but Kuwaiti oil unions have urged authorities to “ensure the safety of workers and infrastructure as the situation develops.” The blockade remains in effect, with no resolution in sight at the time of writing.
